basic_info.main_problem: 我在为新业务取名方面遇到困难，这引发了挫败感和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: 由于命名问题导致创业without法推进，这是此时寻求咨询的重要原因。
growth_experiences: 完成商业Bachelor's degree学位，过程中付出大量努力并坚持not懈，积累了挑战下的成功经验。
Graduated from university后刚开始工作时曾感到overwhelmed，但随着时间推移not断学习与成长，最终胜任岗位。

core_beliefs: 我本质上not够胜任，可能是个失败者

special_situations.event: 为新业务进行命名时迟迟have not满意的名字
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果连名字都想not出来，就说明我not适合创业
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用“应该”自我施压，考虑放弃以减少挫败感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该就此放弃梦想，我显然not适合做这个。

special_situations.event: Every day when handling business-related tasks, the naming problem keeps recurring
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If this step gets stuck, I will inevitably fail on more complex entrepreneurial problems too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Slows down progress, avoids more complex tasks, repeatedly ponders over names to achieve 'perfection' in one go
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果连名字都搞not定，更大的问题我更处理not了。

special_situations.event: 回顾以往完成学位、工作表现Good等积极经历时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 过去的成功not代表现在的能力，这次必须完美，否则等于失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或忽略积极证据，继续聚焦当前困难

special_situations.event: When facing naming tasks, dichotomizes the outcome into 'perfect or failure'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only hitting the perfect name in one try counts as qualified; otherwise he is a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断打磨名字、迟迟not做其他推进，以求一次达成“完美”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果现在not能给出完美名字，我就是失败者。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望实现创业梦想并被视为有能力、能胜任挑战
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被negate，害怕暴露“without能”并因此梦想破灭
defense_goal: 通过早期放弃或缩减投入来规避更大失败与羞辱
以理性辩解维持自我控制并降低Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: not称职、易失败的准创业者
object_relations.object_representation: The harsh judge / perfection standard (the internalized rule of 'must succeed in one go')

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about current difficulties and evidence of ability, or when stuck on the business naming task
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将单一环节的卡顿理解为整体not胜任（把当前困难等同于全面失败）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以平稳、理性的解释语气坚持“因为not起名所以not适合创业”的推论，淡化积极证据；当被挑战时重复理由、以逻辑辩解避免表达情绪。

manifestations: After getting stuck on naming, uses 'should give up' to avoid the pressure of choosing and taking responsibility
将一次任务的结果视为对整体命运的决定性评判
过往成功（完成学位、工作胜任）被其视为“现在毫Meaninglessness”
对自身能力与梦想的价值感下降

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: use“我应该……”的句式（如“我应该放弃我的梦想”）
将“必须一次成功”的完美标准内化为自我要求

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 给自己贴上“失败者”的标签
过度在意是否“配得上”成为创业者，Persistent self-doubt
